search_only: Adoption and business value: find independent implementation evidence, measured outcomes and failures; vendor reports need corroboration.
AI economy and infrastructure: targeted ONS, OECD and World Bank data queries are not implemented.
Business, deals and market structure: search company announcements, filings and independent reporting; establish each deal's actual stage.
UK/EU policy: ICO, CMA, Bank of England, Parliament, AI Security Institute, EU AI Office and EUR-Lex need targeted research.
Additional labs and product changelogs: Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, xAI and Apple require web research.
Independent corroboration: seek accessible reporting and evaluations; links or feed titles alone do not verify claims.
Research papers: arXiv intake is deferred until focused queries and volume limits are chosen.
GitHub watchlist expansion: llama.cpp, PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, MCP SDKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, promptfoo, Langfuse and Phoenix remain proposed.
Discovery platforms are leads only. Promote a lead to authoritative evidence before editorial selection.
